User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the SkillOrbit application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

email.description: User's email address. Null for anonymous users.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

lastLogin.description: Timestamp indicating when the user last logged in.

totalQuizzes.description: The total number of quizzes the user has completed.

totalCorrectAnswers.description: The total number of correct answers across all quizzes.

totalQuestionsAnswered.description: The total number of questions answered across all quizzes.

gamesPlayed.description: The total number of games the user has played.

totalStudyTime.description: Total accumulated study time in seconds.

studyTimeToday.description: Study time for the current day in seconds, resets daily.

currentStreak.description: The user's current daily activity streak.

lastActiveDate.description: The last date the user was active, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

totalXp.description: The total experience points accumulated by the user.

QuizAttempt.title: QuizAttempt
QuizAttempt.description: Represents a single attempt at a quiz by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the quiz attempt.

userId.description: The ID of the user who took the quiz.

totalQuestions.description: The total number of questions in the quiz.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the quiz was completed.

GameScore.title: GameScore
GameScore.description: Represents a score achieved by a user in a game.

id.description: Unique identifier for the game score record.

userId.description: The ID of the user who played the game.

gameId.description: A unique identifier for the game (e.g., 'cosmic-typer').

gameName.description: The display name of the game (e.g., 'Cosmic Typer').

score.description: The score achieved by the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the game was played.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: Represents a single user action for the activity feed.

refId.description: Optional reference to another document (e.g., quizAttemptId).

Achievement.title: Achievement
Achievement.description: Represents an achievement unlocked by a user.

achievementId.description: Key from the predefined achievements list.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Uses path-based ownership for private user data. All user data lives under this path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure authorization independence, clarity, and scalability for the SkillOrbit application.  Authorization Independence is achieved by limiting authorization to `request.auth.uid` only and storing roles in the database.  The structure promotes easy debugging through clear path-based ownership and consistent naming conventions.  The design uses structural segregation to ensure homogeneous security postures for collections.

Private user data is stored under `/users/{userId}`, enabling simple ownership-based security rules. All user-specific progress and activity data are stored in subcollections under the user's document, which naturally inherits the same ownership-based security. This design avoids the use of `get()` calls in security rules by ensuring that all necessary authorization data is available within the document or can be inferred from the path.

QAPs are addressed by ensuring each collection has a homogenous security posture. All documents within a collection have similar security needs. This simplifies security rules and avoids filtering data based on authorization within a single collection.
